title: 3 things GTA 6 does that GTA 5 never could #gta6 #shorts
description: Features per Rockstar's extended look and outlet reports (IGN, GameRant, VGC, Beebom).

scenes.say: Three things GTA 6 does that GTA 5 never could.
Number three. Your in-game phone has a full social feed with viral videos.
Number two. Police track your face, outfit and car, and even CCTV.
Number one. Switch between Jason and Lucia while you explore.
